issues.on_page: Line 18 Local Receipts: Other: General 665.00, Street 157.00, Electric 23,254.00, Total 24,076.00
issues.issue: Not a real split: each fund-column amount (665 / 157 / 23,254) is printed as-is on line 18. The split_from tags on receipts[8], [9] and [10] are harmless for the amounts but send these lines to the split review list unnecessarily (Halsey's identical lines carry no split_from).

The Electric Fund's only receipt (100% of business-type receipts) is unexplained on the page. Its spending is Solid Waste and Water, so it is probably utility charges. Recorded as 'other' with review; a person should confirm.
